title: Work Map Autofix v2 governance contract regression

phases.objective: Align the repository governance graph, runbook, and executable regressions with the existing Work Map Autofix v2 exact-dispatch writer without changing the writer or granting new authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The current Spec Kit Work Map Autofix v2 workflow and its central pipeline connectivity contract
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The reviewer receives deterministic passing evidence only when workflow dispatch, exact-head identity, same-repository pull-request binding, branch exclusions, sole-writer boundaries, idempotent generation, bounded diagnostics, and no-force-push controls agree across policy, documentation, and tests.
steps: Load the current Work Map Autofix v2 workflow without modifying it.
Validate the central writer policy and pipeline declaration against strings and permissions present in the workflow.
Validate the Supervisor runbook describes only the current workflow-dispatch exact-head authorization path.
Run the Pipeline Connectivity and Supervisor Runtime Assurance regressions against the same repository tree.
assertions: Work Map Autofix remains the sole remote writer for docs/work-maps.
The writer is started by workflow_dispatch with an existing same-repository pull-request branch and exact expected_head_sha.
main and Production are rejected as targets, and local plus remote head identity is verified before generation and push.
The removed reopened-pull-request body marker is not treated as an authorization path.
Generation remains idempotent and rejects changes outside docs/work-maps.
The writer uses no force push and publishes bounded v2 diagnostic evidence.
This change modifies governance, documentation, and regressions only; it does not execute the writer or mutate Work Maps.

phases.objective: Observe the next explicitly authorized Work Map Autofix v2 dispatch and confirm exact-head readback and diagnostic evidence under its existing governance boundary.
